disclosure: IW-Cellpose was motivated by earlier analyses of the same BBBC039 test images; freezing limits further adaptation but this is not an untouched confirmatory test.

weight_selection.screen: W in {3, 10}, seeds 0-1, 500 epochs, validation images only
weight_selection.per_run_decoder: flow/cellprob thresholds maximising mean validation object F1 (grid order breaks ties), as in the baseline
weight_selection.score: S(W) = mean selected validation object F1 over seeds 0-1
weight_selection.choice: W maximising S(W); exact ties go to W=3
weight_selection.promotion: promote to test only if S(W) - S(0) >= 0.002 AND neither seed is below its baseline seed; otherwise stop and test no other W

final.frozen: W, code, 500 epochs, seeds 0-9; each seed selects its decoder on validation only
final.primary_endpoint: AJI; d_i = mean over seeds of (AJI_IW[s,i] - AJI_base[s,i]); effect = mean of 50 d_i
final.inference: bootstrap 50 paired image ids, 10,000 draws, RNG seed 0, percentile 95% CI
final.merge_guardrail: pooled touching-nucleus merge rate IW - baseline: upper CI < +1 percentage point required; claim reduced merging only if upper CI < 0

controls_at_selected_W.random_foreground: 5 seeds; per batch, after augmentation, weight exactly as many randomly sampled foreground pixels as contact pixels (separate RNG)
controls_at_selected_W.full_contour: 3 seeds; weight all nucleus contours with excess weight mass matched to the contact weighting per batch
